pins.title: How Much Protein to Build Muscle? Daily Chart by Body Weight
pins.description: How much protein to build muscle do you actually need? Skip the guesswork and stop overpaying for extra shakes. Research places the optimal muscle-building range at 0.7 to 1.0g per pound of body weight (1.6 to 2.2g/kg): 140 lbs = 98 to 140g, 165 lbs = 115 to 165g, 185 lbs = 130 to 185g, 210 lbs = 147 to 210g. See the full protein sources guide and macro calculator at fitway.best. #proteinintake #musclebuilding #nutritiontips

pins.title: Creatine Monohydrate Dosage: How Much to Take Daily (Science)
pins.description: Creatine monohydrate dosage does not require a harsh loading phase or pricey designer blends. Clinical studies show 3 to 5g daily reaches full muscle saturation in 3 to 4 weeks with zero stomach upset, supporting 5 to 15% strength gains and faster cellular recovery. Compare creatine monohydrate vs HCL and check timing tips at fitway.best. #creatine #sportsnutrition #strengthtraining
